regime_context: US thematic leadership is dominated by semiconductors/AI infrastructure, with AI Infrastructure, Memory/HBM, and Semi Equipment occupying the top three ranks — all false on crowding and all scorable via SMH. The detector's only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control (gate_helps=true), so a trend-following lens is defensible here; but rank-IC is ~0 and dir_accuracy is a coin-flip (0.488 on n=84), so I treat ranks as a focus lens and keep conviction low across the board.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Memory, HBM & Storage can close the 0.422 score gap to AI Infrastructure (leader) and take over the rotation.leader slot while SMH holds above its 50-day — if Memory takes the leader rank AND SMH remains above trend, the market will have shown a confirmed within-semi handoff toward the HBM/memory leg.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the closest thing to a coherent trend continuation: it carries the strongest trend signal (hurst_tag='trend') among the top semiconductors, a healthy durability_bar (0.72), and is not crowded (crowding_z 0.15). It sits just behind AI Infrastructure as challenger, which names it as a favored concentration within the semi complex rather than a fresh new idea.
evidence: hurst_tag='trend' (one of only two top semis with a clean trend tag)
theses.dissent: SMH is a single proxy shared across three near-identical semiconductor themes; any long here is really a leveraged bet on the same AI-infra chip complex with no thematic diversification, and the rotation breadth is narrowing (frac 0.41).

falsifier.text: SMH closes below its 50-day moving average before 2026-11-02

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the only eligible theme flagged crowded=true (crowding_z 1.97, the highest in the book) with a high durability_bar (0.83) and clean trend tag. Per guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution, not a short — so the only honest lean is to avoid adding exposure here while the crowding flag stays this elevated.
theses.dissent: Trend and breadth are both strong and uncrowded territory can stay crowded for a long time in reflexive flows; avoiding it costs upside if the cybersecurity narrative keeps running.

falsifier.text: CIBR's crowding_z drops below 1.0 while price makes a new high before 2026-11-02

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
